whole_share_reasons.RVII: Moved out of 'active' into 'whole_share' on 2026-08-24 at the owner's explicit request: RVII is not purchasable in fractional/notional dollar amounts, so its normal $1-$10 graded-ladder buy would always be blocked at the is_tradable_for_fractional_buy gate exactly like BYDDY's. It keeps being evaluated by the same graded ladder as the active universe (it still appears in signals.csv like any other symbol) and is still purchased along with the regular buys -- only the ORDER MECHANISM changes: each day's would-be buy accumulates in the durable whole-share ledger and a single whole-share (quantity-based) order fires once the accumulated total reaches one share's price. As with its original 2026-08-16 addition, no in-repo Robinhood instrument search was run for RVII -- the run-time data-confidence checks still admit or gate it out fail-closed. RVII already carries a $1.00/$1.00 config/per_ticker_sizing.json base (global fallback ladder, no calibrated history), which is what the whole-share path requires. NOTE (added on review the same day): at ~$23.36/share RVII is priced ABOVE circuit_breakers.max_per_order_usd ($10), which would have blocked its fire outright forever -- a whole-share ticker has no unit smaller than one share, so that ceiling reads as 'never buy'. config/budgets.json's circuit_breakers.whole_share_max_per_order_usd ($50) is the allowance that authorizes exactly that one share. See docs/whole_share_accumulation.md.
whole_share_reasons.BYDDY: Not tradable for fractional/notional buys on Robinhood (fractional_tradability != 'tradable'), so the normal $1-$10 graded-ladder buy would always be blocked at the is_tradable_for_fractional_buy gate. Evaluated by the same graded ladder as the active universe -- purchased along with the regular buys -- but routed through the whole-share accumulation path instead: each day's would-be buy accumulates in a durable ledger, and a single whole-share (quantity-based) order fires once the total reaches one share's price. See docs/whole_share_accumulation.md.

whole_share_note: 'excluded' is reserved for a ticker with NO buying mechanism at all (e.g. a delisting/wind-down); a 'whole_share' ticker is never 'excluded' since it IS actively bought, just via a different mechanism -- see 'active', 'excluded', and 'whole_share' above: every symbol in this universe is in exactly one of the three.

GFUZ.reason: Finance (and other read-only market-data providers) may not resolve GFUZ. Robinhood is the primary quote/prior-close source for GFUZ; Alpaca/Finance remain read-only validation/context only.
